name: OCS Restart schedule
plain: Builds a Restart-sampling sigma list from an ordinary schedule and a short text rule, such as 'every 5 steps, jump back 3'. The OCS Sampler sees each jump back up and adds the matching noise. With an empty rule it returns the schedule unchanged.
math:
Rule [n, −k]: after every n steps, append the sigmas from k steps back.
At a jump σ_a → σ_b (σ_b > σ_a): add noise √(σ_b² − σ_a²)·s_noise.

props.needs: a sampler that understands Restart segments (OCS Sampler)
